_readme: A two-home family residence, presented in three material languages. Source deck
No redaction ops on the renders. The furnished plan carried the building's name as a
title line; the top band is cropped off before processing (see unity-picks step).
The deck states its room views are AI design interpretations of the native guide, and

lounge-soft-modern.alt: Main lounge in a pale modern palette with lime plaster walls and a linear bronze pendant
lounge-soft-modern.caption: Soft modern: lime plaster, pale oak, limestone and bronze, with one abstract canvas. Indicative viewpoint.

lounge-contemporary.alt: The same lounge in a contemporary Indian palette with indigo upholstery and a landscape painting
lounge-contemporary.caption: Contemporary Indian: the same room, with indigo textiles, deeper timber and a framed landscape. Indicative viewpoint.

lounge-classical.alt: The same lounge in a light classical palette with a chandelier, cornice and table lamps
lounge-classical.caption: Light classical: cornice, chandelier and lamps — the same furniture plan, a different register. Indicative viewpoint.

bedroom-soft-modern.alt: Principal bedroom in a soft modern palette with an upholstered headboard and reading lights
bedroom-soft-modern.caption: The principal bedroom, soft modern: wall-mounted reading lights and a quiet headboard wall. Indicative viewpoint.

bedroom-contemporary.alt: The same bedroom in a contemporary Indian palette with a timber bed frame and landscape art
bedroom-contemporary.caption: Contemporary Indian: a timber platform bed and warmer bedside lighting. Indicative viewpoint.

bedroom-classical.alt: The same bedroom in a light classical palette with panelled walls and table lamps
bedroom-classical.caption: Light classical: panelled walls, shaded table lamps, and the same bed in the same place. Indicative viewpoint.

lounge-dining-soft-modern.alt: Second lounge and dining room with a suspended jhoola beside the seating group
lounge-dining-soft-modern.caption: The grandparents' lounge and dining, soft modern: the jhoola hangs within the seating group, not apart from it. Indicative viewpoint.

lounge-dining-contemporary.alt: Second lounge and dining room with a painted mural wall and a suspended jhoola
lounge-dining-contemporary.caption: Contemporary Indian: a painted mural carries the wall behind the jhoola. Indicative viewpoint.

lounge-dining-classical.alt: Second lounge and dining room in a classical palette with wall sconces and a framed artwork
lounge-dining-classical.caption: Light classical: sconces and a framed picture replace the mural, same jhoola, same seating group. Indicative viewpoint.

mandir.alt: Mandir niche with a stone counter, brass lamps and a framed pichwai artwork above
mandir.caption: The mandir: a semi-open niche about 2.07 by 0.90 m, planned as part of the room rather than added to it. Indicative viewpoint.

floor-plan.alt: Furnished floor plan of two family homes sharing one floor, with rooms labelled
floor-plan.caption: Two homes on one floor: the parents' home with three bedrooms and two lounges, the grandparents' home with two bedrooms, a lounge and dining, and its own kitchen and mandir.

axonometric.alt: Axonometric study of the whole floor showing walls, furniture and room volumes
axonometric.caption: The whole floor in three dimensions — a material study of the native geometry, not a proposal to demolish anything.

section.alt: Transverse section through the private suite showing a 3657.6 mm finished ceiling height
section.caption: Section A–A through the private suite. The 12 ft finished ceiling is confirmed; opening heads, beams and service zones remain provisional.
